name: After § 52
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 52a. Calls for increased budget appropriations dedicated to the decent reception and integration of migrants and refugees, including the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund; rejects the selective, exploitative, inhumane and criminalising policy promoted by the EU, including by way of the Pact on Migration and Asylum;
